components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a view or dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;height:34px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e7e7ea);background:var(--raise,#fff);color:var(--ink,#18181b);font:540 14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(16 16 24/.06);transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,transform .1s}.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(.5px)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--accent,#4f46e5) 70%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-primary{background:var(--accent,#4f46e5);border-color:transparent;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch,var(--accent,#4f46e5) 40%,transparent),inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.12)}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--accent,#4f46e5) 90%,black)}

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary action: raised fill, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn2{height:34px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e7e7ea);background:var(--raise,#fff);color:var(--ink,#18181b);font:540 14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(16 16 24/.06);transition:background .15s}.ds-btn2:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--raise,#fff) 94%,var(--ink,#18181b))}.ds-btn2:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--accent,#4f46e5) 70%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: Notes / Transcript / Ask switcher in a sunk track.
components.css: .ds-seg{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:3px;background:var(--sunk,#f3f3f5);border-radius:9px;width:max-content}.ds-seg button{height:28px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#6b6b75);font:540 13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-seg button:hover{color:var(--ink,#18181b)}.ds-seg button.on{background:var(--raise,#fff);color:var(--ink,#18181b);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(16 16 24/.06)}.ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--accent,#4f46e5) 70%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Suggestion Chip
components.description: Pill suggestion that tints indigo on hover.
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e7e7ea);background:var(--raise,#fff);color:var(--ink,#18181b);font:400 13.5px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s}.ds-chip:hover{border-color:color-mix(in oklch,var(--accent,#4f46e5) 40%,var(--line,#e7e7ea));background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--accent,#4f46e5) 10%,var(--bg,#fff))}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--accent,#4f46e5) 70%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Action Item
components.description: Custom indigo checkbox row; done state is faint and struck through.
components.css: .ds-action{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font:400 15px/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18181b)}.ds-action:hover{background:rgb(24 24 27/.045)}.ds-action input{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;flex:none;width:17px;height:17px;margin:3px 0 0;border-radius:5px;border:1.5px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--ink,#18181b) 30%,var(--bg,#fff));background:var(--raise,#fff);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer}.ds-action input::after{content:'';width:9px;height:5px;border:2px solid #fff;border-top:0;border-right:0;transform:rotate(-45deg) translate(1px,-1px) scale(0);transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-action input:checked{background:var(--accent,#4f46e5);border-color:var(--accent,#4f46e5)}.ds-action input:checked::after{transform:rotate(-45deg) translate(1px,-1px) scale(1)}.ds-action input:checked+span{color:var(--faint,#9a9aa3);text-decoration:line-through}.ds-action input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--accent,#4f46e5) 70%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.css: .ds-player{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;max-width:560px;padding:7px 14px 7px 7px;border-radius:99px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--raise,#fff) 92%,transparent);border:1px solid var(--line,#e7e7ea);box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgb(16 16 24/.06),0 24px 60px -12px rgb(16 16 24/.28);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);font:400 12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif}.ds-play{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--ink,#18181b);cursor:pointer;flex:none}.ds-play:focus-visible,.ds-speed:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--accent,#4f46e5) 70%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-t{color:var(--muted,#6b6b75);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-track{flex:1;height:4px;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--ink,#18181b) 30%,color-mix(in oklch,var(--ink,#18181b) 14%,var(--bg,#fff)) 30%)}.ds-speed{height:26px;min-width:40px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e7e7ea);background:transparent;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-2,#3f3f46);cursor:pointer}

narrative.overview: The category standard played straight. A white page, a quiet gray sidebar holding the meetings list by day, and a single reading column for the notes. One indigo accent (Uno Work's own) marks the primary action, selected form controls and the current transcript line. Density is calm and Operate-mode: 14px chrome, 15.5px notes. Light and dark both ship; dark follows the system as a full token remap. The plumbing (providers, models, keys) never appears in the main chrome.
keyCharacteristics: White page, #f7f7f8 sidebar, ink #18181b; one indigo accent used on rare, meaningful marks.
One system UI sans for everything, weight and tracking doing the hierarchy; mono only in the raw-notes editor and inline code.
Hairline borders first, shadow second; shadows are soft and blurred, never hard-offset.
1.75px-stroke inline SVG icons from one sprite, 16px, currentColor.
Sentence-case labels everywhere; no uppercase, no tracking-widened labels.
Status color is semantic and sparse: green done, amber due/warning, red error, a separate red for the live recording dot.

rules.name: The One Indigo Rule
rules.body: Indigo marks an action or a selection, never decoration. A screen carries at most a primary button, its checked controls, and the current transcript line in indigo.

rules.name: The Hairline Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with a 1px line or line-soft border; reach for a shadow only for things that float or are being pressed.

rules.name: The Tint, Don't Invent Rule
rules.body: New states are derived with color-mix from existing tokens; do not add a new hue for a new state.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Every label, day header and section title is sentence case at its natural width. No uppercase, no widened tracking, no small-caps captions.

rules.name: The Reading Column Rule
rules.body: Long text sits in a 760px column at 15.5px/1.68; chrome stays at 14px or below.

rules.name: The Float-Only Rule
rules.body: Large shadow means above the page (menu, dialog, player, toast). A panel that sits in the flow gets a border, not a large shadow.

dos: Do keep indigo to the primary action, checked controls and the current transcript line (The One Indigo Rule).
Do use muted for any text a person has to read, and faint only for placeholders and decorative marks.
Do write labels in sentence case and keep page-section titles at 15px, weight 640.
Do build new surfaces from the existing set: panel, row, chip, button, dialog; separate with line-soft.
Do use the sprite icons (16px, 1.75px stroke, currentColor) and tabular numerals for times and counts.
Do ship both themes by adding any new color as a token with a dark value in the prefers-color-scheme block.
Do keep provider, model and key vocabulary out of the main chrome; it belongs behind the Advanced fold in settings.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue or a gradient; derive tints with color-mix from existing tokens.
Don't use hard offset shadows or large shadows on in-flow panels.
Don't introduce uppercase or letter-spaced micro-labels above headings; the build has none and new surfaces should not start.
Don't reach for glyph or emoji icons; add a symbol to the sprite.
Don't use a colored border-stripe on cards or a colored fill for the selected sidebar row (it is a gray press tint).
Don't style a destructive action as a solid red button inside a flow; red text, with a confirm, is the pattern.
Don't inherit the third-party brand colors (Meet green, Zoom blue, Teams violet) as system colors; they are tags for outside products only.
